pr_title: Sort methods in the property selector alphabetically
pr_body:
Method order seemingly random in PropertySelector when inserting function in AnimationPlayer

Fixes #39576
Method name order is now sorted alphabetically through a custom sorter.
pr_comments: @Sl3dge78 Is this still desired? If so, it needs to be [rebased](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/community/contributing/pr_workflow.html#the-interactive-rebase) and tested on the latest master branch. While there are no conflicts, rebasing is important so that reviewers can easily test the PR.
This was an old quick thing I worked on, I'll to rebase it on current version when I have some free time and do a new PR.

Sorry for the late review. That solution makes sense to me, something similar is done in `editor/connections_dialog.cpp` too.

I checked and listing the methods in the order they're defined in the script wouldn't be trivial, it's done by `ScriptTextEditor::get_functions` but this requires having access to the script text and its source path, which seems overkill for this.

Let me know if you're able to rebase this PR, otherwise I can have a look myself.
Closing as it's abandoned, could be salvaged by anyone interested.

issue_context.title: When inserting function in AnimationPlayer using call method track functions are listed in different order than in a source script
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please search existing issues for potential duplicates before filing yours:	
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues?q=is%3Aissue	
-->

**Godot version:**
<!-- Specify commit hash if using non-official build. -->

3.2.1 

**OS/device including version:**
<!-- Specify GPU model, drivers, and the backend (GLES2, GLES3, Vulkan) if graphics-related. -->

Win 10 

**Issue description:**
<!-- What happened, and what was expected. -->

When you use animation player and add new track call method track and then insert key inside this track. Methods listed from a script are placed in seemingly random order rather than in order they appear in the scrip

**Steps to reproduce:**

Described above

**Minimal reproduction project:**
<!-- A small Godot project which reproduces the issue. Drag and drop a zip archive to upload it. -->


applicable in any project.
comments:
I did a bit of digging around for this and the list order behaviour is as follows:
- Methods created before the previous reopening of the editor are in the script order
- All new methods are in the order they were created in, after the old methods

I understand that this would cause inconsistencies.
I could easily sort alphabetically the method list, so that it stays constant through reopenings of the editor. Same could be done for the base classes. Any objections?

If we can't mirror what source file order is alphabetical ordering is better than random order we have now. However ideally it would make more sense to try to mirror what source file order is people put functions in logical places for them.

The method list is updated at compile time and only the changes get added with every compile (which explains the behaviour)
Using the source file's order would require compiling the whole script with every change or add some complex sorting through the parser which I wouldn't be confident enough doing. 
Alphabetical makes more sense to me and my major use case is to use the search box so it's doesn't matter much imo.
Confirmed reproducible in the current `master` branch.
